tob_skipper.text: Staffa, Fingal's Cave, the puffins if the season's right, and Iona on the same ticket. I'm the skipper. The boat is the Ocean Maid, which has been mistaken for a small ferry and a large dinghy.
The Staffa boat sails at twelve. Not before, not after, because the cave is only open when the swell lets us. Three hours there and back.

then.text: The boat leaves the harbour into a long grey swell. Past Ulva, past the Treshnish isles, and then a small green-black island shapes up out of the water, with a great arched mouth in its side. The sea breathes in and out of it.
The boat rounds Ardnamurchan's cousin, Mull's long west coast, and heads for a low green island with a white beach and a small stone abbey. Iona.

else.text: Fair enough. The sea'll be here tomorrow, and so will I.
